en.hubeali: H 14778 – A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Usman Bin Isa, from haroun Bin Kharjat, who has said: Abu Abdullahasws has said:
‘The one who leaves the choice to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and is happy with whatsoever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Chooses for him, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will inevitably Choose good for him’.
en.sarwar: 331. A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Usman Bin Isa, from haroun Bin Kharjat, who has said: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said:
‘The one who leaves the choice to Allah (azwj) and is happy with whatsoever Allah (azwj) Chooses for him, Allah (azwj) will inevitably Choose good for him’.
